channels.body: Disclosure: this is an EcoBack tool we maintain. We added a free supplier-handoff checklist and an editable request template. If the community permits tool posts, feedback on the handoff questions would help.

channels.body: For import teams coordinating CBAM supplier records: ask three different questions. Is the intended record visible? Who owns the verification step if actual emissions are planned? What is the report status or expected availability? EcoBack's free checklist and editable supplier request help organise that conversation. They do not verify emissions or submit declarations.
